Materials: Two identical balls. Measuring tape or ruler Stopwatch or high-speed camera Level platform for height xx) Markers or chalk for marking positions Theory: Time of fall, T = √2h g
Procedural idea:
Ensure the area below the platform is clear of obstacles.
Hold one of the balls at the edge of the platform.
xxiii) Release the ball from rest, allowing it to fall freely.
Use a stopwatch or high-speed camera to measure the time it takes for the ball
to hit the ground.
Repeat this step several times and record the times.
xxvi) Hold the second ball at the same height but give it a horizontal push so it is
thrown horizontally and note the time it takes for the ball to reach the ground
and repeat the steps for several times. Note to tabulate all the data.
Data Analysis: xxvii) Find average time for drop and horizontal throw. xxviii) Compare the average times to demonstrate that they are approximately equal.
